description: This Java source file implements a Vert.x-based AMQP protocol adapter for the Eclipse Hono platform. It handles secure and insecure AMQP connections, manages SASL authentication, processes incoming device messages, handles command links, and forwards telemetry, event, and command response messages to downstream systems. The class extends an abstract protocol adapter base and includes methods for starting/stopping servers, handling connections, processing messages, and managing links.

classes.name: VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter
classes.description: Main class implementing a Vert.x-based AMQP protocol adapter for Eclipse Hono, handling connection setup, message processing, link management, and server lifecycle.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this protocol adapter type, in this case 'amqp'.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the secure and insecure AMQP servers, sets up authentication and connection limits, and binds server handlers.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Stops the secure and insecure servers gracefully.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default port number for secure AMQP connections.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default port number for insecure AMQP connections.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Gets the actual port where the secure server is listening.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Gets the actual port where the insecure server is listening.
